name: mj-mcp-layer-workspace
description: Workspace utilities for MJ MCP Layer automation scripts.

scripts.build: npm --prefix platform run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm run validate:lanes && npm --prefix mcp-layer run typecheck && npm --prefix platform run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix mcp-layer test && npm --prefix platform test
scripts.mj:golden: npm run no-stray && npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run evidence
